instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. Fuel cost is primarily pass-through under capacity purchase agreements / revenue-guarantee code-share agreements with major airline partners.

warnings: Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to major airline partners under capacity purchase/revenue-guarantee agreements. FY ends Sep 30. Fuel pass-through: ~92% of fuel requirements under revenue-guarantee code-share agreements with America West, United, and US Airways. Each $0.01/gal change = $0.1M impact on non-reimbursed fuel. No hedging program.
